text: At its meeting on June 19, 2024, the Board of Directors of CreateTO considered Item RA12.2 and made recommendations to City Council. Summary from the report (June 5, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO: The purpose of this report is to inform the Board of Directors of CreateTO of the ongoing discussions between CreateTO staff and the Toronto Lands Corporation ("TLC"), on behalf of the Toronto District School Board ("TDSB"), in respect of the opportunity to incorporate a public elementary school within the Housing Now development at 770 Don Mills Road. 770 Don Mills Road (the "Site") is a Phase 1 Housing Now site located at the southwest corner of Don Mills Road and Eglinton Avenue East.
